title: Frozen Dinner
caption: Frozen Dinner (V)
game_text: Plays on table. Colo Claw Fish is canceled. Tawss Khaa affects Force drains only at her site. Once per game, may ▲ Pinned Down. While {ovs:8} Ellorrs Madak on table: limit one copy on table, each “2” in its game text is treated as “1”, and opponent may retrieve Force only once per turn.
lore: Freeze dried and ready to serve, a tasty, wholesome Rebel makes a nutritious meal for the whole wampa clan. They’re Gr-r-reat!

notes: Non-unique (no dot on slip heading/caption; printed card is Unrestricted). Banner DEFENSIVE SHIELD (teal shield frame with the red Effect top edge blended in); printed base is a Hoth Immediate Effect. Inline icon before 'Ellorrs Madak' is an orange sphere in a silver ring = the Virtual Set 8 set symbol (Ellorrs Madak (V) is a VS8 card; matches assets/icons/ovs-set-8.png) → {ovs:8}, the same token vs9/45 uses; the wiki stub reads it as 'Light Ellorrs Madak' (differs). ▲ where the stub expands 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Curly double quotes around “2” and “1”. The wiki's default 'Frozen Dinner' page carries Glossary 2.0 errata text; printed face = 'Frozen Dinner (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). The 745 px Hoth-D-frozendinner.gif is tagged D-E1 (errata face, 'cumulatively' bold in its text) — downloaded to src/vs11/22-Hoth-D-frozendinner.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Lore corrected: curly apostrophe in They’re (wiki straight); wording matches. Copyright 1996 (Hoth) by set. Modern: Virtual Block 4 only (VB4 -pre, 348 px).
